exam_scheme.note: MHT-CET (Maharashtra Common Entrance Test) is conducted as an online Computer Based Test (CBT) by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra for admission to First Year of Engineering & Technology (B.E. / B.Tech), Pharmacy (B.Pharm / Pharm.D), and Agricultural Education Professional Degree Courses. The examination curriculum comprises 20% weightage from Maharashtra State Board Class XI syllabus and 80% weightage from Class XII syllabus. The test has no negative marking. Candidates opt for either PCM group (Paper I Mathematics + Paper II Physics & Chemistry, 200 marks, 180 minutes) or PCB group (Paper II Physics & Chemistry + Paper III Biology, 200 marks, 180 minutes) or both.
